verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an incident-management SaaS that stores incident data, call transcripts, and AI outputs, but nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, deletion controls, or data purge capabilities. Related items such as private incidents and audit-log streaming are access and logging features, not retention or deletion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
